DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_RedFlowerBird:
While some say that it flails around to mimic flowers 
swaying in the wind and avoid predators, 
others argue that a crimson flower thrashing violently at high speeds is simply so unsettling that nothing dares approach it.

Lays <itemName id=|Egg| style=|Status_Keyword|/>'s when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_RedFlowerBird:
While in party, 
extends the invincibility period during dodge rolls and dodge steps by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue2}%</>. 
(Does not stack)

Lays <itemName id=|Egg| style=|Status_Keyword|/>'s when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
